issues.problem: Dark outline on the green hamburger button is ~2px and near-black in the reference; build shows a thinner (~1px), lighter outline, so the button reads softer.
issues.fix: Set the menu button to border: 2px solid #1a1f1a (the ink colour) with box-sizing: border-box so the 48px size is unchanged.

issues.problem: Faded bars after the selected year are a darker, more olive green in the reference; build renders them paler and more washed out (lighter lime at low opacity).
issues.fix: Raise opacity of the future bars (approx 0.45 -> 0.6) or use a darker fill such as rgba(150,170,80,0.6) instead of the lime at low alpha; check for a mix-blend-mode in the Figma layer.

issues.problem: Selected white bar has a ~2px dark outline in the reference; build outline is thinner (~1px). Prev/next arrows are also ~1px left and slightly smaller than reference (1386/1409 vs 1385/1408).
issues.fix: border: 2px solid #1a1f1a on the selected bar; bump arrow font-size by ~1px and shift right 1px.

issues.problem: Selected 'Lo-fi' chip is ~2px taller and 1px wider than reference (about 38px vs 36px high), so it no longer matches the height of the neighbouring chips; EDM and Classical are pushed 1px right; Hip-hop is ~1px narrower so Jazz sits 1px left.
issues.fix: Give selected and unselected chips the same box: identical height (36px) and a border on both states (transparent border on the selected one) rather than adding border/padding only when selected.

issues.problem: 'Word descriptions (voice)' row sits ~2px lower than reference (label baseline y~631 vs 629) while Captions and Mono audio rows match, so row spacing is 29/30 instead of 30/30.
issues.fix: Remove the extra 1-2px top margin/padding on the first accessibility row; use a uniform 30px row height from the ACCESSIBILITY heading.

issues.problem: All five labels are 1px lower than reference (176/208/240/272/304 vs 175/207/239/271/303) while the checkbox squares are in place, so label and box are slightly misaligned vertically.
issues.fix: Tighten label line-height or add transform: translateY(-1px) / align-items: center on the checkbox rows.

issues.problem: The three stop cards plus the Add place / Share row are all 1px higher than reference (card 1 top 93 vs 94; Add place text y 325 vs 326). Title and header line above are in place.
issues.fix: Add 1px to the gap between the mixtape title and the first card (margin-top +1px on the list).

issues.problem: Sub-2px drifts: Help key badge 1px left, 'Keyboard map' 1px right with its K badge 2px right (275 vs 273); caption pill 1px narrower (right edge 379 vs 380); VOLUME label 1px right.
issues.fix: Reduce gap between Help label and its kbd by 1px offset, and trim keyboard-map label letter-spacing/gap by 1-2px; add 1px horizontal padding to the caption pill.

notes: Very close reproduction: every element is present, text content matches exactly, and the map, route, pins, player and settings panel line up to within 1-2px. Remaining differences are stroke weights (menu button, selected year bar), the tint of the faded future year bars, a slightly oversized selected genre chip, and a handful of 1-2px vertical drifts in the settings rows and mixtape list. No missing, extra, or distorted elements were found.
